```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using GeometryBasics: Point3f

to_points3(x, y, z) = Point3f.(Float32.(x), Float32.(y), Float32.(z))

function plot_trajs_lines_cairo(ax, x, y, z; color=:red, linewidth=2, label="", alpha=0.85)
    pts = to_points3(x, y, z)
    lines!(ax, pts; color=color, linewidth=linewidth, label=label, alpha=alpha)
    return pts
end
```

```{julia}
function downsample_points(pts::Vector{Point3f}; max_points::Int=800)
    n = length(pts)
    n <= max_points && return pts
    idx = round.(Int, range(1, n, length=max_points))
    return pts[idx]
end
```

```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using GeometryBasics: Point3f

to_points3(x, y, z) = Point3f.(Float32.(x), Float32.(y), Float32.(z))

function plot_acc_traj_3d_cairo(sa1t1, sa1t2, sa1t3,
                                sa2t1, sa2t2, sa2t3,
                                sa3t1, sa3t2, sa3t3;
                                mapping=nothing,
                                outfile_base="acc_traj_3d",
                                azimuth_deg=12,
                                elevation=0.13pi)

    fig = Figure(size=(900, 700), figure_padding=(20, 160, 20, 20)) # extra right padding for zlabel
    ax = Axis3(fig[1, 1],
        xlabel = mapping === nothing ? "Task 1" : mapping[sa1t1.task_id[1]],
        ylabel = mapping === nothing ? "Task 2" : mapping[sa1t2.task_id[1]],
        zlabel = mapping === nothing ? "Task 3" : mapping[sa1t3.task_id[1]],
        azimuth = azimuth_deg * pi/180,
        elevation = elevation,
    )

    pts1 = to_points3(sa1t1.accuracies, sa1t2.accuracies, sa1t3.accuracies)
    pts2 = to_points3(sa2t1.accuracies, sa2t2.accuracies, sa2t3.accuracies)
    pts3 = to_points3(sa3t1.accuracies, sa3t2.accuracies, sa3t3.accuracies)

    # Points + lines
    meshscatter!(ax, pts1; color=:red,   markersize=0.01)
    meshscatter!(ax, pts2; color=:blue,  markersize=0.01)
    meshscatter!(ax, pts3; color=:green, markersize=0.01)

    lines!(ax, pts1; color=:red,   linewidth=2)
    lines!(ax, pts2; color=:blue,  linewidth=2)
    lines!(ax, pts3; color=:green, linewidth=2)

    # emphasize final points
    meshscatter!(ax, [pts1[end]]; color=:red,   markersize=0.03)
    meshscatter!(ax, [pts2[end]]; color=:blue,  markersize=0.03)
    meshscatter!(ax, [pts3[end]]; color=:green, markersize=0.03)

    limits!(ax, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1)
    ax.aspect = :data

    # zlabel clipping fixes
    ax.zlabeloffset = 50
    resize_to_layout!(fig)

    # Save: make PNG high-res
    #save(outfile_base * ".png", fig; px_per_unit=3)
    #save(outfile_base * ".pdf", fig)

    return fig
end
```

```{julia}
using GeometryBasics: Point3f

# helper: 3 vectors -> Vector{Point3f}
to_points3(x, y, z) = Point3f.(Float32.(x), Float32.(y), Float32.(z))

"""
    make_acc_traj_3d(; ... ) -> Figure

Plots three 3D trajectories (points + lines) in [0,1]^3.
Pass in your sa?t? objects (must have .accuracies vectors and .task_id[1] if mapping is used).
"""
function make_acc_traj_3d(sa1t1, sa1t2, sa1t3,
                          sa2t1, sa2t2, sa2t3,
                          sa3t1, sa3t2, sa3t3;
                          mapping=nothing,
                          azimuth_deg=12,
                          elevation=0.13pi,
                          labelsize=20,
                          ticklabelsize=18)

    fig = Figure(size=(800, 650), figure_padding=(20, 120, 20, 20))
    ax = Axis3(fig[1, 1],
        xlabel = mapping === nothing ? "Task 1" : mapping[sa1t1.task_id[1]],
        ylabel = mapping === nothing ? "Task 2" : mapping[sa1t2.task_id[1]],
        zlabel = mapping === nothing ? "Task 3" : mapping[sa1t3.task_id[1]],
        azimuth = azimuth_deg * pi/180,
        elevation = elevation,
    )

    # build full trajectories
    pts1 = to_points3(sa1t1.accuracies, sa1t2.accuracies, sa1t3.accuracies)
    pts2 = to_points3(sa2t1.accuracies, sa2t2.accuracies, sa2t3.accuracies)
    pts3 = to_points3(sa3t1.accuracies, sa3t2.accuracies, sa3t3.accuracies)

    # points (meshscatter is reliable in 3D)
    meshscatter!(ax, pts1; color=:red,   markersize=0.01)
    meshscatter!(ax, pts2; color=:blue,  markersize=0.01)
    meshscatter!(ax, pts3; color=:green, markersize=0.01)

    # connect with lines (optional but helpful)
    lines!(ax, pts1; color=:red,   linewidth=2)
    lines!(ax, pts2; color=:blue,  linewidth=2)
    lines!(ax, pts3; color=:green, linewidth=2)

    # highlight endpoints
    meshscatter!(ax, [pts1[end]]; color=:red,   markersize=0.03)
    meshscatter!(ax, [pts2[end]]; color=:blue,  markersize=0.03)
    meshscatter!(ax, [pts3[end]]; color=:green, markersize=0.03)

    # cosmetics
    ax.xgridcolor = (:gray, 0.3)
    ax.ygridcolor = (:gray, 0.3)
    ax.zgridcolor = (:gray, 0.3)

    ax.xlabelsize = labelsize
    ax.ylabelsize = labelsize
    ax.zlabelsize = labelsize
    ax.xticklabelsize = ticklabelsize
    ax.yticklabelsize = ticklabelsize
    ax.zticklabelsize = ticklabelsize

    ax.xticks = ([0, 0.5, 1.0], ["0", "0.5", "1"])
    ax.yticks = ([0, 0.5, 1.0], ["0", "0.5", "1"])
    ax.zticks = ([0, 0.5, 1.0], ["0", "0.5", "1"])

    ax.aspect = :data
    limits!(ax, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1)

    # zlabel cropping fix
    ax.zlabeloffset = 30
    resize_to_layout!(fig)

    return fig
end
```

                       mapping=mapping)
